build_cross_attention_backend: build a cross-attention backend by wrapping an underlying attention backend with encoder-decoder slot mapping
create_cross_attention_layer: create a CrossAttention layer for encoder-decoder models with configurable heads, head size, and scale
get_cross_slot_mapping: get cross-attention slot mappings from encoder sequence lengths and block table tensors
build_cross_attention_metadata: build cross-attention metadata with non-causal attention and encoder sequence length handling
get_kv_cache_spec: get the KV cache spec for cross-attention with block size, KV heads, head size, and quantization mode
